title: The Conference of Fragmented Validity

features.name: consensus strata
features.desc-on-touch: You find the places where all versions of the field agree: the northern boundary, the rain-line, the names nobody disputes. Between agreements, the field fractures into argument.

features.name: variant testimony
features.desc-on-touch: Each surface here records a different version of how the field learned it was plural. The arguments don't resolve; they deepen. This is the archive learning to hold contradiction as true.

features.name: unresolved plural
features.desc-on-touch: The field's true name was never singular. Here, all its versions call out together—in the same instant, from the same location, contradicting each other perfectly.

features.name: verification stand
features.desc-on-touch: Here the archive tests each version against its own logic. Not to collapse them to one truth, but to measure how far each reaches before it breaks. Each break is a boundary the field discovered.

features.name: divergence root
features.desc-on-touch: The place where all versions branched from a single measurement. Before this root, the field was counted as one. After it, the counting cracked open.

inscription: you stand in the place where the field finally spoke all its names at once

file.name: Field_Versions_Plurality_Argument_Log.txt
file.note: Each line is a version defending its own counting. None resolve. The file grows longer every time it is read.

exits.label: back toward the singular field, where the plural was first suspected
northward where the consensus boundary hardens
southward into deeper argument, where versions multiply
westward deeper into the field's own plurality chamber
